subject: Web Development
title: Server Components: A New Paradigm
description: A quick win: understand Server Components: A New Paradigm.

hook.text: React Server Components let components run on the server and send only HTML to the browser.

buildup.text: Server components can access databases directly without APIs or client-side data fetching.

discovery.text: This cuts JavaScript bundles dramatically — server code never reaches the user's device.

twist.text: The mental model is confusing. Some components run on the server, others on the client.

climax.text: Server Components blur the line between frontend and backend in ways that challenge conventions.

punchline.text: The server and browser are merging.

quiz.question: What can server components access directly?
